newsitem.title: UK: UK's Nationwide says house prices up 1.6% in March.
newsitem.headline: UK's Nationwide says house prices up 1.6% in March.

text.p: The Nationwide Building Society released the following UK house price data -
HOUSE PRICES (index base Q1 1983=100) March Feb Mar,96
Nationwide's head of research Paul Sanderson said the figures may exaggerate the underlying picture.

"The sharp rise in prices recorded in March may exaggerate underlying trends. Nevertheless there is ample evidence that an extreme shortage of quality properties for sale, primarily in London and the south east, is resulting in strong upward pressure on prices in some areas."
He said the reluctance of homeowners to place their current property on the market, preferring to wait until they have found a new home, is restricting supply and frustrating potential sales.
Slower growth in mortgage lending and a reported fall in property transactions also suggests a supply logjam may now be constraining activity.
